description: This file defines the SpContainer class which models a shape or group shape container within the Escher drawings in PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes properties for shape positioning, flags, type, options, and hierarchy management.

classes.name: SpContainer
classes.description: Represents a shape or shape group container within the Escher drawing structure, managing positional data, shape properties, and hierarchy within a spreadsheet.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent SpgrContainer object that contains this shape container.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent SpgrContainer of this shape container.

methods.name: setSpgr
methods.description: Designates whether this shape is a group shape.

methods.name: getSpgr
methods.description: Checks if this container is a group shape.

methods.name: setSpType
methods.description: Sets the shape's type identifier.

methods.name: getSpType
methods.description: Retrieves the shape's type identifier.

methods.name: setSpFlag
methods.description: Sets shape-specific flags.

methods.name: getSpFlag
methods.description: Retrieves shape-specific flags.

methods.name: setSpId
methods.description: Sets the shape's index ID.

methods.name: getSpId
methods.description: Retrieves the shape's index ID.

methods.name: setOPT
methods.description: Sets an individual option property for the shape.

methods.name: getOPT
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option property value.

methods.name: getOPTCollection
methods.description: Returns the entire options array.

methods.name: setStartCoordinates
methods.description: Sets the top-left cell coordinate of the shape.

methods.name: getStartCoordinates
methods.description: Gets the top-left cell coordinate of the shape.

methods.name: setStartOffsetX
methods.description: Sets the horizontal offset from the top-left cell measured in 1/1024 of a column width.

methods.name: getStartOffsetX
methods.description: Gets the horizontal offset measurement.

methods.name: setStartOffsetY
methods.description: Sets the vertical offset from the top-left cell measured in 1/256 of a row height.

methods.name: getStartOffsetY
methods.description: Retrieves the vertical offset measurement.

methods.name: setEndCoordinates
methods.description: Sets the bottom-right cell coordinate of the shape.

methods.name: getEndCoordinates
methods.description: Gets the bottom-right cell coordinate of the shape.

methods.name: setEndOffsetX
methods.description: Sets the horizontal offset of the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: getEndOffsetX
methods.description: Gets the horizontal offset of the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: setEndOffsetY
methods.description: Sets the vertical offset of the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: getEndOffsetY
methods.description: Gets the vertical offset of the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: getNestingLevel
methods.description: Determines the nesting depth of this shape container within shape group containers.
